name: Waitlist For Tutor LMS
author: Anowar Hossain Rana

sections.description:
Waitlist For Tutor LMS is an easy-to-use addon that adds a waitlist to Tutor LMS courses. When a course is full, students can join the waitlist and get email alerts when spots open. Admins can manage waitlists, notify students, and track enrollments from a simple dashboard.

Key Features

  • “Join Waitlist” button displayed on fully booked Tutor LMS courses
  • Email notifications to waitlisted students when spots are available
  • Admin dashboard to view and manage waitlist entries with separate sections for “Waitlist” and “Enrolled Users (From Waitlist)”
  • Bulk “Notify All” option to email all waitlisted students for a course with one click
  • Individual “Notify” and “Delete” actions for precise waitlist management
  • Export waitlist data to CSV for each course
  • Visual status indicators (“Waiting” in orange, “Notified” in green) for easy tracking
  • Modern admin UI
  • Total waitlist counter displayed in the admin header
  • Automatic integration with Tutor LMS student data to identify enrolled users from the waitlist

How It Works

  1. For Students: When a course is full, students see a “Join Waitlist” button, enter their email, and join the waitlist.
  2. For Administrators: Access the “Waitlists” menu under Tutor LMS to:
    • View active waitlist entries and enrolled users who were on the waitlist
    • Notify individual students or all at once when spots open
    • Export waitlist data or delete unwanted entries
    • Monitor total waiting students across all courses

This plugin requires Tutor LMS to be installed and activated.

Additional Information

For support or feature requests, visit Website or submit a Feature Request. Check out more Tutor LMS addons at Video for Tutor LMS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the waitlist-for-tutor-lms folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure Tutor LMS is installed and active
  4. The waitlist feature will automatically integrate with fully booked courses
